## Packages

- `@ndigo/ai` — Provider-agnostic agent contracts: chat messages, streaming events, structured output, and a tool-calling loop over MCP tools
- `@ndigo/ai-sdk` — AI SDK integration layer for Ndigo: the only package that imports the Vercel AI SDK
- `@ndigo/auth-client` — Client-side authentication for Ndigo — AuthClient, ClientAuthGuard, and OIDC adapter
- `@ndigo/auth-core` — Core authentication types, interfaces, and passive decorators for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/auth-server` — Server-side authentication for Ndigo — AuthServer, AuthRouteGuard, and JWT adapter
- `@ndigo/boot` — Application bootstrap, profiles, and typed configuration for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/cache` — Isomorphic caching for Ndigo — memory cache manager, memoize, and the @cached decorator
- `@ndigo/cli` — The Ndigo framework CLI — app lifecycle, scaffolding, db migrations, and DX commands
- `@ndigo/cluster` — Process supervisor for Node.js applications — replicated worker slots with signal relay, graceful drains, and bounded-backoff restarts (AD-74)
- `@ndigo/content` — i18n content keys, themes, and the MessageSource contract for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/content-i18next` — Ndigo Content i18next Adapter
- `@ndigo/context` — Application context, environments, configuration, and events for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/core` — Foundational primitives, contracts, and utilities for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/dispatcher` — Request dispatch, parameter binding, and radix handler mappings for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/dom` — Ndigo DOM – Isomorphic DOM parsing integration layer
- `@ndigo/factory` — IoC factory with scopes, lifecycle, and aware processors for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/flags` — Feature flags for Ndigo — the FlagEvaluator SPI (typed, async, never-throw), the property-backed local provider, and the @whenFeature gate metadata
- `@ndigo/flags-openfeature` — OpenFeature bridge for Ndigo flags — the FlagEvaluator over @openfeature/server-sdk (and the web SDK for the ./web entry), so vendor providers (flagd, OFREP, LaunchDarkly, …) arrive behind the existing SPI
- `@ndigo/host` — Ndigo Host — centralized micro frontend orchestration in the shell context
- `@ndigo/http` — Fetch-based HTTP client, interceptors, and content parsing for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/inspect` — Deterministic JSON manifest generator for Ndigo applications (routes, mappings, config keys)
- `@ndigo/jobs` — Durable job queues, worker execution, and the transactional outbox for Node.js
- `@ndigo/locks` — Distributed locks with fencing tokens for Node.js — the single-executor primitive behind multi-node @scheduled and cluster work
- `@ndigo/log` — Isomorphic logging core for Ndigo — logger abstraction, severity mappings, and threshold filtering on the OpenTelemetry API
- `@ndigo/management` — Ndigo management endpoints — /health and /metrics (actuator-style)
- `@ndigo/mcp` — Model Context Protocol tools projected from Ndigo dispatch metadata
- `@ndigo/openapi` — OpenAPI 3.0 documentation for Ndigo apps — spec generation from dispatch metadata + Swagger UI
- `@ndigo/orm` — Ndigo ORM - Repository and Data Mapper persistence abstractions
- `@ndigo/orm-drizzle` — Ndigo ORM Drizzle – Drizzle ORM adapter for @ndigo/orm
- `@ndigo/oxlint-plugin` — Consumer-facing oxlint rules for Ndigo applications — paradigm, view, route, and logging guards
- `@ndigo/platform-node` — Node.js platform adapter for Ndigo — HTTP server, auto-configuration, static files, multipart
- `@ndigo/platform-web` — Browser platform adapter for Ndigo — dispatcher glue, history/cookie resolvers, themes
- `@ndigo/proxy` — Container-managed method interception for Ndigo — metadata annotations, interceptor chains, and Proxy-based weaving
- `@ndigo/rate-limit` — Fixed-window rate limiting for Node.js — the policy contract, the in-process default limiter, and the shared-store driver seam for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/redis` — Node-only Redis connections, namespaced shared cache adapters, WebSocket pub/sub fan-out, distributed-lock/job drivers, and the shared-store rate limiter for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/resilience` — Retry, circuit breaking, and backoff policies for Ndigo — interceptors built on @ndigo/proxy
- `@ndigo/router` — Route registry, path partitions, and feature routing for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/scheduler` — Cron scheduling for Node.js — @scheduled tasks and the task registry
- `@ndigo/service` — Typed service clients and server-sent event streaming for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/signals` — Ndigo Signals – Reactive state management with signals, computed values, and effects
- `@ndigo/socket` — Ndigo Socket — isomorphic WebSocket domain: client contract + implementation and server-side session contracts
- `@ndigo/telemetry` — Isomorphic telemetry core for Ndigo — API-only: logger, metrics, severity, tracing decorators
- `@ndigo/telemetry-node` — Node.js telemetry for Ndigo — NodeSDK configuration and Node platform instrumentations
- `@ndigo/telemetry-web` — Browser telemetry for Ndigo — browser telemetry configuration and web instrumentations
- `@ndigo/test` — Ndigo integration test harness — MockMVC-style in-process request dispatch
- `@ndigo/ui` — Ndigo UI — brand tokens, theme layers, and the design-system registry contract
- `@ndigo/util` — Zero-dependency helper utilities — type guards, strings, environment, crypto
- `@ndigo/view` — Views, view targets, and content negotiation for Ndigo
- `@ndigo/view-ejs` — Ndigo View EJS — server-side EJS template rendering as an isomorphic Ndigo view technology.
- `@ndigo/view-toon` — TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) view technology for Ndigo — text/toon output, a negotiation resolver, and a prompt encoder.
- `@ndigo/view-webcomponent` — Web Component view technology for Ndigo — component creation and event binding
- `create-ndigo-app` — Scaffold a standalone Ndigo application (node or browser kind).
